call_DiaProcessor: call DiaProcessor to encode text and audio inputs for text-to-speech generation or training
batch_decode_DiaProcessor: batch decode audio codebook sequences from DiaProcessor into audio waveforms using DacModel
build_indices_DiaProcessor: build precomputed index tensors for applying or reverting delay patterns across audio codebook channels
apply_audio_delay_DiaProcessor: apply audio delay pattern to batched token tensors using precomputed indices and BOS/PAD token masking
save_audio_DiaProcessor: save audio waveforms to disk files using soundfile at the configured sampling rate
